scope: One presentation-only map release notice; no fluent review claimed.

entries.source: AI maps keep tank tops and more foliage visible across the property line.

drafts.zu: Amamephu e-AI agcina iziqongo zamathangi namahlamvu engeziwe zibonakala ngale komngcele wendawo.
drafts.st: Dimmapa tsa AI di boloka dihlooho tsa ditanka le mahlaku a mangata di bonahala ka nqane ho moedi wa sebaka.
drafts.ts: Mimepe ya AI yi hlayisa tinhlohla ta mathangi ni matluka yo tala swi vonaka ku tsemakanya ndzilakano wa ndhawu.
drafts.ve: Mapa dza AI dzi ita uri zwipiḓa zwa nṱha zwa mathangi na maṱari manzhi zwi vhonale zwi tshi pfuka mukano wa fhethu.
